summary: iBio filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing a press release with preclinical body-composition data from an eight-week obese non-human primate study of IBIO-610, an Activin E antibody candidate, plus semaglutide. Presented at the EASD Annual Meeting on October 1, 2026, results showed fat comprised 93% of weight lost versus 77% for semaglutide alone. No transactional terms, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics were stated, and no special-situation event occurred. The filing is an ordinary product-data disclosure; risk-arb angle is not applicable.
